implementationTasks.title: S1: Expose a cached workspace usage cockpit projection
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md where applicable, docs/header-usage-cockpit/index.html and its recorded decisions, docs/operations/admin-design-guideline/index.html, docs/quality/design-principles.md, and docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md. This is an implementation slice of AGT-2913, not authorization to implement other slices. Respect the selected decisions rather than assuming the recommendations were approved. Use central tokens, existing components, English copy, no em dashes, no decorative left accent bars, no third-party font requests. Do not alter routing or admission floors. Use API/backend ownership for task and git operations. Do not commit or push. Start a dev backend only through the permitted Playwright fixture from stable. Preserve existing routes, keyboard actions and task semantics. Report changed files and verification, with both-theme screenshots for visual changes.

Deliver one authorized read projection for the usage strip. Proposed path: GET /api/workspace/usage-cockpit; reconcile with current Task Server/connector route ownership before mapping it. Reuse quota/admission snapshots, active-run identities and the canonical token ledger union. Read backend/Features/Cli/CliEndpoints.cs, backend/Features/Tokens, contracts/TaskServer.Contracts/ProviderUsageNormalization.cs and docs/system/domains/tokens.md. Return the envelope, provider windows, decimal USD totals, project split including Workspace / unassigned, active run effective model/reasoning and source, slot counts, optional advisory budget metadata, source freshness and coverage described in the Dossier Data contract. Calendar day/week must use the recorded decision, with explicit boundaries. Include ETag/data revision. A read must use cached aggregates, not scan the workspace or launch a CLI. This slice owns contracts and server tests only; no header UI or new admission policy.

Dependencies: recorded cost-calendar and primary-number decisions. The canonical AGT-2882 cached-input normalization must be present; if missing, declare that dependency rather than adding a second pricing implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- The endpoint exposes both quota windows with nullable values, reset timestamps, account scope and distinct unknown/unsupported/limited states; no percent aggregation across accounts.
- Canonical Codex cached input is charged exactly once; a fixture with raw input 100000 and cache 80000 produces uncached 20000 and cache-read 80000. Historical pricing and normalization remain intact.
- Live/terminal overlap is deduplicated, active spend is a subset of period totals, project children plus unassigned equal the total, and unknown-price rows result in explicit partial coverage.
- Tests cover midnight and Monday boundaries, late receipt replacement, missing source, stale source, unauthorized projects, multiple accounts and zero active runs; header reads do not trigger CLI probing or per-request full scans.

Use S1 to replace the current shell strip contents with one chip per pinned CLI, a cost chip and a slot chip. Primary owners are frontend/src/app/features/shell/components/status-bar and frontend/src/app/features/tokens; preserve public test IDs or migrate callers deliberately. - Every configured CLI has both window slots with known, unsupported or unknown values; the two primary CLI groups and separate today/week cost, unique active count and reported live spend render from the API.

- Component integration and relevant Playwright tests cover success, empty and partial snapshots. Desktop screenshots prove consistent chip centerlines and both themes.

Apply the Dossier Responsive layout and recorded narrow-layout, strip-placement and model-location decisions to the integrated S2 strip. Use available shell/container width, not only viewport width. Recommended layout is 40 px desktop, 48 px tablet/laptop, and two 52 px rows on phone. Make counts, values and units indivisible. Move whole navigation groups and slot fractions to the appropriate popover/More before overflow; retain one text-only menu with all original destinations and signed-in actions. Make additional provider alarms discoverable through More. Preserve two pinned providers in a stable order. Reconcile 44 px coarse-pointer targets, browser zoom, large amounts, longer provider names and pushed side sheets. Relocate the existing Defaults for new tasks control per the recorded decision without changing active runs. Task effective route and next-message composer scope must stay distinct. Replace the old operational strip, never duplicate it.

Dependencies: S2 delivered and all five decisions recorded. Scope is shell layout and existing default-model control placement, not board card internals or pipeline rework.

Acceptance criteria:
- At 390, 768 and 1440 px the selected layout shows complete quota windows, both period costs and active spend with no clipped values, overlapped controls or page-level horizontal scroll.
- Boundary tests at 320, 479/480, 767/768, 1023/1024, 1279/1280 and 1800/2560 verify measured strip height, density and whole-group fallback, including side-sheet narrowing and long amounts.
- More retains Usage, Orchestrator, Feed, Settings, model defaults, additional providers and authenticated actions, with keyboard menu behavior and no hidden duplicate tab stops.
- Model changes apply only to their declared new-task/next-message scope, the effective active route remains visible in details, and both-theme Playwright screenshots cover all three primary widths.

implementationTasks.title: S4: Add advisory usage alarms and telemetry freshness
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
Read AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md where applicable, docs/header-usage-cockpit/index.html and its recorded decisions, docs/operations/admin-design-guideline/index.html, docs/quality/design-principles.md, and docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md. Use central tokens, existing components, English copy, no em dashes, no decorative left accent bars, no third-party font requests. Do not alter routing or admission floors. Use API/backend ownership for task and git operations. Do not commit or push. Start a dev backend only through the permitted Playwright fixture from stable. Preserve existing routes, keyboard actions and task semantics. Report changed files and verification, with both-theme screenshots for visual changes.

Implement the Dossier Chip states in the S1-S3 usage cockpit. Use raw quota values for >80 percent, optional same-scope/calendar USD advisory budgets for amount > budget, and provider admission snapshots for Limited. Add freshness to each source, unknown/unsupported distinction, partial-cost coverage and last-known-data behavior. Quota/active freshness recommendation is 120 seconds; ledger aggregates 5 minutes. Use one deduplicated polite live region for state entry; ordinary updates stay silent. Clearing requires a fresh resolving sample; stale data never clears a known limit. Add a narrowly scoped budget setting to the existing usage/settings surface only if no compatible advisory budget source exists, with explicit currency, basis, timezone, day/week and scope, default unset. Do not add spend enforcement, scheduling changes, model downgrades or independent provider probes.

Dependencies: S1-S3 and recorded cost-calendar decision. Preserve correctness floors under all quota/cost states.

Acceptance criteria:
- Fixtures at 79.9, 80.0, 80.1 and 100 percent and reset-window rollover prove exact threshold and recovery behavior; displayed rounding cannot hide a warning or imply a false limit.
- An $80 weekly advisory budget with $84.60 measured usage shows $4.60 over; exactly $80 is not crossed, unset is silent, and partial known subtotal can prove over-budget but cannot prove under-budget.
- Limited, stale, partial, unknown, unavailable and concurrent alarms remain distinguishable using text/shape and semantic tints in both themes; overflow preserves hidden-provider alarms.
- Playwright verifies focus stability, one state-entry announcement, no repeated announcements on polling, no flash under reduced motion and complete values on mobile; no run/admission policy is mutated.
